preconditions.description: The height of the grid is between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The width of the grid is between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of days is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == w for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid has exactly w cells.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'.', '#'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '.' (allowed) or '#' (permanently blocked).
The cell with Limak's house and the cell with his school are not permanently blocked.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ki <= 10 for ki in [len(temp_blocks) for temp_blocks in days])
preconditions.description: The number of temporarily blocked cells on each day is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ri <= h and 1 <= ci <= w for day in days for ri, ci in day)
preconditions.description: Each temporarily blocked cell is within the grid boundaries.

preconditions.expression: all(grid[ri-1][ci-1] == '.' for day in days for ri, ci in day)
preconditions.description: None of the temporarily blocked cells are permanently blocked.

preconditions.expression: all((ri, ci) not in [(1, 1), (h, w)] for day in days for ri, ci in day)
preconditions.description: None of the temporarily blocked cells are Limak's house or school.

postconditions.description: The output for each day is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if is_interesting_day(grid, days[i]) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the day is interesting, otherwise 'NO'.
